title: The Night of the Full Recharge
skyStory: The moon reaches one hundred percent in Gemini, completely full, the brightest it will be all year. Gemini, the twins, holds two mirrors up to the sky, and the moonlight bounces everywhere: off snowbanks, frozen ponds, the windows of the cabin and the waves at the shore. Saturn takes off its party hat. Mars puts down its sparklers. Everyone just stares.

reading: Tonight is the true full moon, and the cabin glows silver in the snow. Yesterday was for celebrating. Tonight is for recharging. The Fire Tiger has been burning bright all year and the onyx has been working hard on your wrist. Time to let them both rest under the moon.

Before bed, place the onyx bracelet on a windowsill where the moonlight can reach it. Next to it, place something that reminds you of Nancy. Gemini loves pairs, so tonight the pair is everything. The [[Temperance]] angel is pouring water between two cups, perfectly balanced. Fire and Mountain, side by side under the brightest moon of the year.
joel.mission: Set the onyx on a moonlit windowsill tonight with one small token that reminds you of Nancy.
joel.omen: Moonlight so bright you can see your shadow on the snow. You are fully charged for the year ahead.

reading: The shore under a full moon is the most magical place in the world, and tonight it is yours. The waves are silver. The trees are black lace. The ruby on your right pinky looks almost violet in this light, glowing like it has been waiting all year for this exact moment.

Place the ruby on a windowsill tonight, beside the pearl and the diamonds, all five stones lined up like a tiny Captain Planet council. Earth, Fire, Water, Wind, Heart, recharging together. Gemini is the sign of twins, and you and Joel are twins of a sort: two turning points, two cardinal signs, two stones swapped.
nancy.mission: Line up all five of your stones on a moonlit windowsill tonight and leave them there until morning.
nancy.omen: A frozen pond or puddle reflecting the full moon perfectly. Your intentions are mirrored back.
nancy.stoneWhy: the little moon meets the big one

together.text: Full Moon Recharge, the real one. Both of you set your stones under tonight's full moon at the same time. Then text each other the same message: charged. That's it. That's the whole ritual. The moon will do the rest.
